beats.care: Border tension shapes defence spending, China app and trade rules, and the price of Chinese-made gadgets you buy.
beats.what: The Ministry of External Affairs said Chinese troops sometimes leave agreed patrol routes, which 'disturbs' the border.
beats.why: The outgoing chief of the Indo-Tibetan Border Police said face-offs have been happening in Arunachal Pradesh since July. It's the first official admission since the 2024 peace deal.

cards.body: Spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal said both sides use diplomatic and military channels to avoid 'miscalculation'. The video of the ITBP chief's speech was later deleted from ITBP's YouTube channel.
More than two years after Modi and Xi announced a détente.

cards.body: Officially confirming the clashes took a newspaper report and a police chief's speech that was then quietly taken down.

learn.t: The Line of Actual Control (LAC) is the unmarked line separating Indian and Chinese-held land, about 3,488 km long.
